title: Grinding noise when braking

causes.text: Scraping noise = brake pad wear limit indicator
causes.document: 2022 Toyota Camry Owner's Manual OM06244U (year mapping per Helm listing; manual is Camry-specific)

causes.text: Grinding noises are a sign brakes need service

urgency.text: Dangerous to drive when pad/disc wear limits exceeded; rotor damage may result
urgency.document: 2022 Toyota Camry Owner's Manual OM06244U (year mapping per Helm listing; manual is Camry-specific)

guidancePrimary: universal: Car Care Council — do not postpone brake repair to the metal-to-metal point (potentially dangerous); Toyota: scraping wear-indicator noise = check/replace pads as soon as possible

guidance.text: Never put off routine brake inspections or any needed repair, such as letting the brakes get to the "metal-to-metal" point, which can be potentially dangerous and lead to a more costly repair bill. Grinding is the noise brakes make at that stage.
guidance.document: Car Care Council, "Stop and Check Your Brakes" (Brake Safety Awareness Month, published 2020-08-03; non-profit consumer education organization)
guidance.answers: can_i_keep_driving: grinding = do not keep postponing; metal-to-metal is potentially dangerous — have the brakes inspected as soon as possible

verdict.action: Book the car in now; do not keep driving on it
verdict.detail: Grinding is the metal-to-metal stage, which the source calls potentially dangerous and more expensive to repair.

guidance.text: Scraping noise (brake pad wear limit indicator): have the brake pads checked and replaced as soon as possible.
guidance.document: 2022 Toyota Camry Owner's Manual OM06244U (year mapping per Helm listing; manual is Camry-specific)
guidance.answers: vehicle-specific: Toyota says inspect/replace as soon as possible

guidance.text: Brake system warning light (red): the brake fluid level is low, or the brake system is malfunctioning. Toyota's instruction is to stop the vehicle in a safe place immediately and contact a dealer, because continuing to drive may be dangerous.
guidance.document: 2022 Toyota Camry Owner's Manual OM06244U (year mapping per Helm listing; manual is Camry-specific)
guidance.quote: Brake system warning light ... Immediately stop the vehicle in a safe place and contact your Toyota dealer. Continuing to drive the vehicle may be dangerous.
guidance.answers: stop driving: red brake system warning light means stop in a safe place

verdict.condition: Red brake-system warning light on, or the pedal suddenly sinks or goes hard
verdict.action: Stop in a safe place; do not drive on to the shop
verdict.detail: Toyota is the only manufacturer manual we have checked for this page. The row is tagged Toyota because the wording is Toyota's; the instruction itself is about the condition, not the brand.

firstStep.text: Grinding is not a self-check symptom: the pad or wear-limit condition behind it can only be confirmed by inspecting the brakes. Have the vehicle inspected as soon as possible, and avoid letting it reach metal-to-metal.
firstStep.document: Car Care Council, "Stop and Check Your Brakes" (Brake Safety Awareness Month, published 2020-08-03; non-profit consumer education organization)
firstStep.answers: shop vs self: shop inspection as soon as possible — no reliable self-check for grinding

hub.note: Grinding is metal against metal: the friction material is gone and the backing plate is cutting the rotor. This is the point where a pad-and-rotor job becomes a caliper and hardware job, which is why the source material treats it as a stop-driving condition rather than a noise to live with.
hub.verdict: No — have it inspected before driving further.
